items.title: Carissa’s Wierd Announce First New Album In 25 Years
items.summary: If you went to a lot of warehouse shows in the early '00s, you were probably familiar with Carissa's Wierd, a band who made music way too beautiful for their surroundings. Back then, it was totally normal to walk into a punk-house basement and hear soul-transporting folk-rock harmonies. Now, in retrospect, Carissa's Wierd feels more like a strange little miracle, so it's great to see that they're about to return with their first new album in a quarter-century. The post Carissa’s Wierd Announce First New Album In 25 Years appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Mike D :: Thank You
items.summary: With Mike D's Thank You , ascribed. to the appellation Mike D 5D, we finally have a solo debut from a Beastie Boy. That’s changed with Thank You, the first solo work from Mike D, ascribed to the appellation Mike D 5D. Though he hasn’t been too far from music, producing records for Portugal. The Man and Soft Play, the album follows a long period of creative grief. But the work of his sons Davis and Skyler Diamond and their circle of friends have drawn the wildest Beastie back to writing and performing once again. The post Mike D :: Thank You first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .

items.title: Crying Laughing :: Talking
items.summary: Strange and turbulent times call for insistent new theme songs and rallying cries. On Talking , Baltimore’s Crying Laughing answer the call with necessary and emphatic instrumental anthems, driven by a twin alto sax attack and percussion that channels the snap and bounce of New Orleans rhythms.
